answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 is also strong because pipeline quality and enterprise sales assistance are close proxies for sustainable qualified revenue, though it lacks realized revenue and retention evidence. Memories 31, 73, and 86 provide useful but indirect support: activation, acquisition, onboarding, time-to-value, and revenue lift are relevant leading indicators, but they omit qualified-revenue quality, retention, margins, and longer-term outcomes. Memory 91 is least supported because it only reports week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no evidence of revenue, qualification, retention, or durability.
